title: Business Information Security Officer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Information Security Officer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.


Job Title: Business Information Security Officer (BISO / BSO)


Role Summary

The Business Information Security Officer (BISO/BSO) serves as the primary security liaison between the business, enterprise security, and GRC functions. The role ensures that information security risks are appropriately identified, assessed by accountable teams (e.g., GRC, vendor risk, compliance), clearly communicated to business stakeholders, and effectively acted upon.


The BISO enables secure-by-design execution across business initiatives while ensuring alignment with enterprise security frameworks and regulatory requirements such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, and FedRAMP.


Key Responsibilities

1. Secure-by-Design Advisory & Consulting


Act as a trusted security advisor to business and delivery teams, embedding security-by-design principles into initiatives from early design stages.

Translate enterprise security standards and regulatory requirements (ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, FedRAMP) into actionable guidance and security user stories.

Collaborate with architecture, engineering, and security teams to ensure security requirements are understood and incorporated into solution design.


2. SDLC Security Enablement (Coordination Role)


Ensure security requirements are integrated into SDLC processes for in-scope applications.

Coordinate with GRC, application security, and engineering teams to ensure security assessments, control validation, and remediation activities are executed.

Track security findings and ensure remediation plans are clearly understood and actioned by delivery teams.


3. Third-Party Risk & Due Diligence Coordination


Act as the business-facing liaison for third-party risk management activities conducted by GRC and vendor risk teams.

Ensure due diligence requests are completed by relevant stakeholders and that outcomes are communicated in business terms.

Facilitate business understanding of vendor risk posture and support informed risk decisions.


4. Divestiture / Transformation Support (Orthopedic Programs)


Support security activities for orthopedic divestiture and transformation initiatives.

Coordinate across IT, GRC, security, and business teams to ensure security requirements are addressed during transition planning and execution.

Ensure alignment with enterprise security frameworks and regulatory obligations throughout the transformation lifecycle.


5. Physical Site Security Coordination


Support physical security assessments for scoped orthopedic sites conducted by appropriate security teams.

Ensure findings, gaps, and remediation actions are clearly communicated to business and site leadership.

Track remediation progress and support closure of identified risks.


6. Risk Governance, Communication & Collaboration


Facilitate security risk acknowledgement and decision-making discussions between GRC and business stakeholders.

Ensure risks, control gaps, and mitigation plans are clearly understood and appropriately documented.

Enable risk acceptance processes by ensuring business stakeholders are informed and aligned.

Collaborate across multiple teams (GRC, IT, engineering, legal, compliance, and business units) to ensure coordinated security outcomes.


Key Deliverables

Security-by-design guidance aligned to ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, and FedRAMP frameworks

Coordinated tracking of SDLC security activities and remediation status

Third-party risk communication summaries (from GRC outputs)

Divestiture security coordination artifacts and transition support documentation

Physical site assessment coordination reports and action tracking

Risk acknowledgement and acceptance documentation

Executive-level security status reporting for business stakeholders


Core Competencies

Strong understanding of enterprise security frameworks: ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, FedRAMP

Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills

Ability to translate technical risk into business impact and decision-ready language

Strong coordination


Equality & Opportunity for All

Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws


At HCLTech, we don’t just offer jobs — we offer journeys. Join a global team where your work drives innovation, your ideas matter, and your growth is supported every step of the way.


Why Choose HCLTech?

  • Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint
  • Collaborate with diverse teams across borders
  • Work on cutting-edge technologies in enterprise integration
  • Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Software Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This is a fully remote position, PJ model and salary range is 25-30/hr USD.



Required Qualifications

  • CMS Backend: Strong PHP development experience and deep familiarity with the Symfony framework, Composer package management, and Twig templating engine.
  • API Experience: 3+ years experience designing and writing content-driven GraphQL and REST APIs in microservices-based architectures.
  • Data & Search: Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience with popular open-source RDBMS, plus search technology such as Solr or Elasticsearch.
  • Cloud & Containers: Experience with cloud architecture (ideally AWS) and production experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Engineering Fundamentals: Excellent understanding of Object-Oriented Programming and Design, with strong ability to architect and develop enterprise-level applications and backend systems.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Process & Tooling: Experience working with agile processes and version control systems (Git).
  • Education & Experience: BS in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of experience building scalable, production-grade backend services and content platforms.
  • Strong proficiency in server-side languages, asynchronous programming, and modern object-oriented design patterns.
  • Experience designing and consuming APIs (REST and GraphQL) in microservices-based architectures.
  • Experience modeling complex data flows and schemas for transactional and integration workflows.
  • Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or OCI) and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with distributed systems concepts including caching (Redis, Memcached) and messaging systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ).
  • Strong debugging and performance troubleshooting skills, including use of monitoring/observability tools.
  • Soft Skills: Strong initiative, creative thinking, and the ability to work in a collaborative, innovative, flexible, and team-oriented environment. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Passion for sports and a dedication to creating exceptional fan experiences.


.

Preferred Qualifications

  • CMS Exposure : Exposure to popular proprietary or open-source CMS systems such as WordPress, Drupal, Joomla, or Magento.
  • Additional Languages : Exposure to Golang and/or Rust for performance-critical services.
  • Cloud Focus : 3+ years working with cloud technologies (AWS is strongly preferred).
  • Certifications : Cloud certifications (AWS, GCP, OCI).
  • Frontend Skills : Working knowledge of Node.js, TypeScript, and React/Next.js sufficient to collaborate on full-stack features and contribute to shared tooling.
  • Web Fundamentals : Familiarity with HTML, CSS (layout, specificity, cross-browser compatibility), and Web Components.
  • Collaboration : Proven experience in cross-team collaboration for requirements, implementation, and testing.
  • AI Tooling : Experience with AI development tools (Cursor, Copilot, etc.) to optimize engineering workflows.
  • Enthusiasm : Enthusiasm for learning new frameworks and languages.


We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to be a key member of our Content Management engineering team


What You Will Do

  • Architect Backend Services: Design and develop new business-led content management services and APIs with an emphasis on performance, scalability, and reliability.
  • Drive Full-Stack Solutions: Work closely with DevOps on backend solutions to complex problems, ensuring scale and availability across our content platforms.
  • Build CMS Infrastructure: Develop services and APIs that enable editors to create visually-rich and data-driven content experiences, and streamline backend workflows so stakeholders can produce more content quicker.
  • Integrate AI/ML: Integrate content classification ML/AI processes and pipelines to better annotate video and image assets, enabling smarter aggregation and distribution.
  • Modernize Legacy Systems: Upgrade and migrate existing legacy backend services into modern frameworks, and adapt and optimize current systems for deployment on cloud-based infrastructure.
  • Platform Consolidation: Facilitate better content distribution and aggregation within the various business units, and contribute to consolidating distinct CMS platforms used across the organization.
  • Operational Excellence: Provide engineering support to stakeholders, ensuring a high level of service availability with appropriate testing, monitoring, observability, and alerting.

title: Estagiário de Experimentação CRO/UX
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Estagiário de Experimentação CRO/UX em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Olá, somos a ETUS

Somos uma MadTech, atuamos na interseção entre marketing, mídia e tecnologia, com soluções que conectam marcas e pessoas de forma estratégica, automatizada e orientada por dados.

ETUS significa Eu Tenho Um Sonho. Nascemos com o propósito de transformar vidas por meio do empreendedorismo, da inclusão e da inovação. Em poucos anos, construímos um ecossistema completo de empresas focadas em performance, mídia programática, inteligência de dados, tecnologia SaaS e otimização de conversão (CRO).

Hoje, impactamos milhões de pessoas, com uma equipe apaixonada por desafios, crescimento e propósito. Aqui, acreditamos que sonhar é o primeiro passo para transformar realidades.

Se você procura um ambiente dinâmico, e já se imaginou trabalhando com um bando de gente incrível, que ama o impossível e está sempre disposta a mudar o jogo, seu lugar é aqui.

Sobre a oportunidade

Esta vaga é para atuar na Supersonic, uma das marcas que fazem parte do ecossistema ETUS.

A Supersonic é especializada em crescimento digital, performance e otimização de resultados, atuando de forma estratégica na construção de experiências digitais orientadas por dados, conversão e comportamento do usuário. Com foco em inovação, tecnologia e experimentação, a empresa desenvolve soluções voltadas para aumento de performance, evolução de produtos digitais e aceleração de resultados para diferentes negócios e segmentos.

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa com mente curiosa, olhar analítico e forte interesse por CRO e Experimentação para atuar em projetos de diferentes nichos, modelos de negócio e contextos digitais. Alguém que queira ir além de ajustes superficiais de interface e fazer parte de uma rotina que une estratégia, comportamento do usuário, análise de dados, copywriting, UX, otimização contínua e construção de hipóteses com potencial real de impacto.

Essa pessoa atuará diretamente na identificação de oportunidades ao longo das jornadas e funis de conversão, estruturando análises, levantando hipóteses, conduzindo iniciativas de otimização e contribuindo para a evolução da maturidade de experimentação nos projetos e clientes atendidos pela Supersonic.

Buscamos um perfil que enxergue CRO como uma disciplina estratégica, estruturada e orientada por dados, aprendizado contínuo e conexão genuína com os objetivos do negócio. ● Utilizar ferramentas de IA para apoiar pesquisas, análises, organização e produtividade.

● Participar de reuniões, acompanhamentos e apresentações junto ao time, desenvolvendo comunicação e visão estratégica.

O que esperamos de você:

● Afinidade com CRO, UX, comportamento do usuário, marketing digital ou dados.

● Interesse por investigação, pesquisa, análise e resolução de problemas.

● Boa escrita e capacidade de organizar ideias com clareza.

● Boa comunicação verbal para participar de reuniões, explicar raciocínios e conduzir apresentações.

● Curiosidade para aprender ferramentas, processos e metodologias.

● Interesse em utilizar IA como ferramenta de trabalho.

A contratação será para atuação em regime remoto, com possibilidade de deslocamentos pontuais à sede ao longo do ano, conforme necessidade. Todas as despesas relacionadas às viagens serão custeadas pela empresa.

title: Senior Solution Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Solution Architect em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role


Our client helps organizations turn complex data into actionable intelligence. As a Senior Solution Architect , you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and optimizing enterprise-grade analytics deployments for customers with complex technical and business needs.

You will partner closely with customers, internal stakeholders, and product teams to ensure successful outcomes across architecture, deployment, scalability, and long-term value realization.


Why Join the Solution Architect Team?

  • Work at the intersection of customer success, cloud architecture, and data platforms.
  • Help customers solve complex infrastructure, deployment, and performance challenges across our client’s environments.
  • Collaborate with Product, R&D, Support, and Customer Success teams to shape best practices and improve the platform.
  • Influence architecture decisions for strategic customers and high-visibility engagements.


In This Role, You Will

  • Lead custom multi-node Linux installations and upgrades for our client’s deployments, including troubleshooting complex deployment issues.
  • Own and troubleshoot multi-node Windows-to-Linux migration projects, backup and restore processes, and architecture-related escalations.
  • Analyze logs, system performance, and infrastructure telemetry to proactively identify risks and optimize customer environments.
  • Partner with customer Application Developers, DevOps engineers, IT teams, and executive sponsors to drive successful outcomes.
  • Act as the voice of the customer by sharing product feedback, submitting bugs and feature requests, and influencing roadmap priorities.
  • Lead enablement initiatives for internal teams, mentor Solution Architects, and support technical interviews for new hires.


What You’ve Accomplished So Far

  • 5+ years of experience in customer-facing technical roles, including previous experience as a Solution Architect.
  • Hands-on expertise with Linux (Ubuntu, Amazon Linux, RHEL/CentOS), Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and cloud platforms such as AWS EKS and GKE.
  • Strong experience troubleshooting distributed systems, networking, security, and monitoring tools such as Grafana and Coralogix.
  • Advanced working knowledge of MongoDB or other NoSQL databases, including query optimization and troubleshooting.
  • Intermediate SQL skills, with the ability to join data across disparate sources and optimize queries.
  • Proficiency in scripting and programming using Bash, Python, JavaScript, and CSS.
  • Experience with load-testing tools such as K6 and modern cloud data warehouse technologies (Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery) is a plus.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical teams and executive stakeholders.


How You’ll Ramp Up

By Day 30

  • Build a strong understanding of our client’s architecture, deployment models, product capabilities, and customer engagement processes.

By Day 60

  • Independently lead standard and custom deployment activities.
  • Troubleshoot escalations and support customer architecture reviews.

By Day 90

  • Own complex technical engagements end-to-end.
  • Mentor junior team members.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with TypeScript.
  • Exposure to Node.js environments such as Express or NestJS.
  • Experience working on data-intensive, analytics, marketplace, or real estate technology platforms.

  • Proactive problem-solver who takes ownership of projects and outcomes.

title: SDR Sênior / Executivo(a) de Desenvolvimento de Negócios B2B | EdTech SaaS | Remoto com Comissão

A Liza é uma startup de EdTech que utiliza Inteligência Artificial para ajudar professores a economizar tempo e melhorar a gestão pedagógica. Nossa plataforma apoia professores no planejamento de aulas, criação de atividades, elaboração de avaliações, organização de informações dos alunos e otimização das rotinas escolares diárias.

Nossa equipe atua entre os Estados Unidos e o Brasil, combinando execução no estilo do Vale do Silício com profundo conhecimento do sistema educacional brasileiro. Lisa Zhang, Fundadora: fundadora internacional baseada no Vale do Silício

Fernando Cofiel, COO: ex-COO da Maple Bear por 9 anos, com experiência em operações escolares, expansão e franquias

Rogério Luiz, CTO: PhD em Ciência da Computação com foco em Inteligência Artificial

Estamos em busca de um(a) SDR Sênior / BDR Sênior para apoiar o crescimento da Liza no mercado educacional brasileiro. Esta é uma vaga comercial remota, com foco em prospecção consultiva, qualificação de oportunidades, agendamento de reuniões com decisores estratégicos e apresentação inicial do produto para potenciais clientes.

Esta vaga é ideal para alguém com forte experiência em vendas B2B, SaaS, CRM e desenvolvimento de negócios , que tenha segurança para conduzir abordagens por telefone, e-mail, WhatsApp, LinkedIn e chamadas por discador/dialer .

Buscamos uma pessoa organizada, proativa, orientada a metas, autodisciplinada e capaz de gerenciar um pipeline comercial estruturado em um ambiente de startup acelerado.

Atenção: embora esta seja uma vaga remota, isso não significa uma posição flexível ou de baixa pressão. Esta é uma função comercial de alta performance, com metas exigentes, forte potencial de comissão e bônus, e expectativa clara de execução diária. A vaga é indicada para um(a) SDR Sênior ambicioso(a), motivado(a) por resultados, confortável com pressão e preparado(a) para ajudar a impulsionar o crescimento da Liza no mercado educacional brasileiro.

Principais Responsabilidades
  • Prospectar escolas, redes de ensino, Secretarias Municipais de Educação e parceiros estratégicos no Brasil
  • Identificar e qualificar leads inbound e outbound
  • Realizar prospecção ativa por telefone, e-mail, WhatsApp, LinkedIn e discador/dialer
  • Agendar reuniões com Secretários(as) de Educação, gestores escolares, coordenadores pedagógicos e outros decisores
  • Realizar apresentações iniciais do produto para potenciais clientes
  • Explicar de forma clara como a Liza pode apoiar professores, coordenadores, escolas e redes municipais de ensino
  • Entender as necessidades, prioridades e dores de cada potencial cliente
  • Qualificar oportunidades comerciais reais e identificar os próximos passos
  • Gerenciar follow-ups com disciplina e consistência
  • Avançar oportunidades ao longo do funil de vendas
  • Manter o CRM sempre atualizado com interações, notas de reunião, próximos passos e status do pipeline
  • Apoiar conversas iniciais de parcerias e vendas
  • Ajudar a adaptar mensagens comerciais e estratégias de abordagem para o mercado educacional brasileiro
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com a liderança para melhorar os processos de prospecção, qualificação e conversão
  • Representar a Liza de forma profissional em interações com educadores, gestores públicos e parceiros institucionais
Requisitos
  • Graduação completa
  • Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência em vendas, pré-vendas, SDR, BDR, desenvolvimento de negócios ou áreas comerciais
  • Forte experiência com prospecção ativa e qualificação de leads
  • Experiência em vendas B2B, preferencialmente em SaaS, tecnologia, educação ou soluções para o setor público
  • Familiaridade com plataformas de CRM, como Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Brevo ou similares
  • Experiência com abordagens comerciais por telefone, e-mail, WhatsApp, LinkedIn e ferramentas de discador/dialer
  • Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal em português
  • Capacidade de conduzir conversas consultivas com diferentes perfis de decisores
  • Capacidade de apresentar um produto de forma clara, confiante e profissional
  • Forte organização para gerenciar pipeline, follow-ups e múltiplos contatos ao mesmo tempo
  • Alto nível de autodisciplina e responsabilidade individual
  • Conforto para trabalhar com metas, pressão, rejeição e execução rápida
  • Perfil proativo, resiliente, ambicioso e orientado a resultados
  • Conforto para trabalhar em um ambiente de startup em rápido crescimento
Diferenciais
  • Experiência no mercado educacional brasileiro
  • Experiência vendendo para escolas, redes de ensino ou Secretarias de Educação
  • Experiência com setor público ou vendas para governos
  • Conhecimento sobre processos de compras públicas no Brasil
  • Experiência prévia em empresas SaaS

Buscamos alguém que faça mais do que apenas enviar mensagens. Esta pessoa deve saber construir relacionamentos, entender o contexto do cliente, qualificar oportunidades reais e apresentar o produto de forma conectada às necessidades do potencial cliente.

A pessoa ideal é disciplinada no uso do CRM, forte em follow-up, confortável em lidar com objeções e capaz de transformar listas de contatos em reuniões qualificadas e oportunidades comerciais.

Esta vaga é ideal para alguém ambicioso, persistente, maduro comercialmente e motivado por crescimento baseado em performance.

  • Está buscando um trabalho remoto tranquilo
  • Procura uma vaga com horários flexíveis e pouca cobrança diária
  • Não se sente confortável com alto volume de prospecção
  • Evita ligações ou conversas diretas com clientes
  • Não gosta de trabalhar com metas, KPIs e rotina de follow-up
  • Precisa de supervisão constante para manter produtividade
  • Está buscando uma vaga de SDR iniciante
O Que Oferecemos
  • Trabalho 100% remoto
  • Vaga comercial em tempo integral
  • Alto nível de autonomia
  • Impacto direto no crescimento da empresa
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar com uma liderança internacional
  • Possibilidade de crescimento para posições comerciais mais estratégicas
  • Ambiente rápido, empreendedor e orientado a resultados
  • Impacto direto no setor educacional brasileiro
  • Forte potencial de comissão e bônus para profissionais de alta performance
Remuneração

Salário base de R$5.000 a R$10.000 por mês , conforme experiência, mais comissão e bônus por performance.

A remuneração variável poderá ser baseada em reuniões qualificadas, oportunidades geradas, apresentações de produto realizadas, conversão de leads e avanço no pipeline comercial.

Modelo de Trabalho

Esta é uma vaga remota, em tempo integral e de alta performance comercial . A posição exige execução diária, rotina estruturada, uso consistente do CRM, disciplina de follow-up e forte compromisso com metas comerciais.

title: Legal Administrative Assistant/Secretary
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Legal Administrative Assistant/Secretary em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This is the role where attorneys stop worrying about whether anything is going to slip through the cracks. Calendars they trust. Dockets that don't drift. Court, BIA, and tribal-court filings that always go through. Billing that closes on schedule. Confidential records handled with the discretion the work requires.


Our client is a leading Arizona litigation firm headquartered in Phoenix, with active practices in commercial litigation, civil rights, employment law, and Federal Indian Law — including matters before the Bureau of Indian Affairs and tribal courts. The firm represents businesses, individuals, families, and tribal nation interests, and offers the expertise of large national firms with a smaller, more personal approach.


The firm runs on Clio for case management, calendaring, and billing. You will support attorneys and the onshore team directly — owning the operational discipline that determines whether the lawyers can focus on the law or get pulled into the operational background. This is a substantive operational ownership role, not a queue-clearing admin seat.


Success at 90 days: zero missed deadlines, calendars attorneys rely on without checking twice, clean billing close, organized matter files. Success at one year: you know BIA procedures and tribal court rules well enough that attorneys default to you for procedural questions, not the other way around.


Key Responsibilities

Docketing & Calendar Management

  • Docket hearings, court dates, filing deadlines, BIA deadlines, tribal court deadlines, and critical case milestones in Clio.
  • Set structured multi-tier reminder cascades for every deadline (30-day, 14-day, 7-day, 2-day, day-of) — never a single calendar entry.
  • Manage attorney calendars including appointments, court dates, depositions, agency hearings, internal deadlines, and travel windows.
  • Surface upcoming deadlines and scheduling conflicts to attorneys with sufficient lead time — proactively, not reactively.

Meeting, Deposition & Travel Coordination

  • Coordinate scheduling for client meetings, depositions, hearings, agency appearances, and internal team meetings.
  • Arrange travel logistics for attorneys (flights, accommodations, transportation, itineraries) for hearings and client visits.
  • Prepare deposition logistics including notices, court reporter coordination, and witness confirmation.
  • Confirm all logistics in advance and communicate relevant details to all parties.

Legal Document Preparation

  • Prepare, edit, proofread, and format pleadings, motions, briefs, correspondence, and other legal materials to filing-ready quality.
  • Ensure all documents meet applicable court, agency, and firm formatting standards before filing or distribution.
  • Maintain version control and organized document files across all active matters inside Clio.
  • Assist attorneys with drafting standard correspondence and follow-up communications as directed.

Court & Agency Filing

  • E-file with federal district courts (CM-ECF/PACER), Arizona state courts, BIA, and tribal courts as applicable.
  • Confirm acceptance of every filing via NEF or equivalent — submission is not the same as acceptance.
  • Maintain organized records of all submissions, confirmations, and proofs of service.
  • Stay current on e-filing requirements for the courts and agencies the firm uses.

Case & File Management (Clio)

  • Maintain matter records inside Clio with consistent naming conventions and complete metadata.
  • Track case activity and organize supporting documentation.
  • Maintain and organize physical and digital client files.
  • Handle confidential client records and case information with the highest level of discretion and in compliance with applicable professional responsibility rules.
  • Support case intake — opening new matters in Clio, gathering client information, preparing conflict checks.

Billing, Invoicing & Expense Tracking

  • Track attorney time entries, billing activity, and client invoices inside Clio.
  • Assist with preparation and distribution of client billing statements.
  • Process and track expense reports and reimbursements.
  • Flag missing time entries, overdue invoices, or discrepancies to the appropriate team member before billing close.

Compliance & Procedure

  • Maintain awareness of procedural rules relevant to the firm's Indian law practice — federal administrative procedures, tribal court rules, federal court local rules, BIA processes.
  • Support the firm's compliance with document retention, confidentiality, and professional responsibility obligations.
  • Ensure all administrative procedures comply with applicable legal, court, and agency requirements.


Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years in a legal admin, legal secretary, or paralegal role supporting a US litigation practice (or strongly comparable international firm).
  • Hands-on US court e-filing experience (CM-ECF, PACER, AZTurboCourt, or similar) — direct workflow experience, not familiarity.
  • Direct experience managing multiple attorney calendars with structured, multi-tier deadline cascades.
  • Excellent written English — documents you prepare or proofread require minimal attorney correction.
  • Meticulous attention to detail. Accuracy in legal documents and deadlines is non-negotiable.
  • High discretion in handling confidential client and case information.
  • Self-directed and reliable in a remote work environment.
  • Stable home office: high-speed internet, backup power or backup internet, quiet workspace, modern computer with webcam.


Strong Plus, Not Required

  • Direct paid Clio experience — matter setup, calendar integration, document management, and billing.
  • Equivalent experience with Filevine, MyCase, ProLaw, Smokeball, or comparable case management systems.
  • Familiarity with Bureau of Indian Affairs procedures, tribal court rules, or federal administrative practice.
  • Experience with LEDES invoicing or other legal billing standards.
  • 12+ months of sustained US-firm remote experience.


How We Work

  • 100% remote.
  • full-time contractor.
  • Compensation: up to $6/hr USD.


Application

Complete the required Aptive Index assessment here and provide a comprehensive resume.

Link:


By applying, you consent to being contacted via the contact information provided in your application for recruitment purposes only.


Scheduling: initial calls run in US Mountain Standard Time, within a 3:00 AM – 1:00 PM MST window — which translates locally to 6:00 PM – 4:00 AM in the Philippines, 12:00 PM – 10:00 PM in South Africa, 7:00 AM – 5:00 PM in Brazil, and 4:00 AM – 2:00 PM in Guatemala.

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (German)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote AI Quality Analyst (German) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • German Proficiency: Ability to read and write in German with a high degree of comp, as German is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve:
  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and upto 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months
  • Our offered rate for this project is $15 per hour.


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form .
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours .
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements .


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

Remote (specific timezones) - GMT-10:00 to GMT-02:00

We aim to use AI-assisted technology to scale our protocols to address mental health burden around the world. \"

  • You are proficient in Stakeholder management, Project management, Online learning, LMS administration, Knowledge management, Instructional design.
  • English - Fully fluent


Responsibilities and more:

Educational Content Producer


SoundMind is seeking an Educational Content Producer to help build a new platform centered around conversations, learning, intellectual curiosity, and accessibility.


The role will support Dr. Hannah McLane in producing interviews, educational content, learning experiences, and member resources across topics including psychology, psychoanalysis, neurodiversity, trauma, coercive control, psychedelics, contemplative traditions, medicine, creativity, and human development.


This is not a traditional podcast production role. We are looking for someone who loves learning, enjoys working with experts and educators, and is excited about transforming conversations into meaningful educational experiences.


What You'll Help Create

  • Each month, Dr. Hannah interviews researchers, clinicians, philosophers, educators, artists, and other thought leaders.


You will help transform those conversations into:

  • Learning collections
  • Reading guides
  • Discussion questions
  • Course modules
  • Summaries and key takeaways
  • Member resources
  • Accessibility-focused learning materials
  • Podcast and video content


Responsibilities


Content Production

  • Coordinate guest interviews and recordings
  • Organize transcripts and source materials
  • Create educational summaries and discussion guides
  • Curate reading lists and supplemental resources
  • Organize content into themed learning collections
  • Assist with course and membership content development


Faculty & Guest Coordination

  • Schedule guests and manage communications
  • Collect bios, headshots, readings, and permissions
  • Prepare briefing materials before interviews
  • Ensure recordings, assets, and materials are properly organized


Learning Experience Design

  • Help create engaging learning experiences from expert conversations
  • Work with subject matter experts to develop educational materials
  • Assist in organizing content for LMS platforms and member portals
  • Identify opportunities for future courses, collections, and educational offerings


Accessibility & Multi-Modal Learning

  • We are particularly interested in making learning more accessible across different learning styles and neurotypes.


You may help develop:

  • ADHD-friendly summaries
  • Dyslexia-friendly formats
  • Text-to-speech resources
  • Audio versions of readings
  • Visual learning aids
  • Multi-modal educational experiences


Ideal Background


You may be:

  • An instructional designer
  • Educational content producer
  • Learning experience designer
  • Curriculum developer
  • Educational project manager
  • Online learning specialist


Experience with any of the following is helpful:

  • LMS platforms (Kajabi, Canvas, Blackboard, Thinkific, etc.)
  • Course development
  • Podcast or video production
  • Educational technology
  • Adult learning
  • Psychology, healthcare, coaching, or wellness education


What We're Looking For


The ideal person is:

  • Curious
  • Organized
  • Excellent at written communication
  • Comfortable coordinating busy experts
  • Interested in lifelong learning
  • Able to transform complex ideas into accessible educational experiences
  • Excited by intellectual conversations and interdisciplinary thinking


Most importantly, we are looking for someone who loves helping ideas come alive.


Compensation: $10–15 USD/hour depending on experience.LATAM strongly preferred. Part-time contract role with opportunity to grow as the platform expands.


Your potential leader:

  • Hannah McLane

title: Remote Business Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Business Analyst em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems.

Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


About the Role:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Business Analyst to support evaluation and annotation workflows focused on quality, accuracy, and structured reasoning. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working with digital tools, performing side-by-side evaluations, and providing clear, well-supported justifications based on fact-checking.


Responsibilities:

  • Perform side-by-side (SxS) evaluations on GHD, comparing outputs and assessing quality, accuracy, and relevance.
  • Conduct fact-checking to validate information and identify inconsistencies or inaccuracies.
  • Provide detailed, well-structured justifications to support evaluation decisions.
  • Follow established evaluation guidelines and quality standards consistently.
  • Use browser-based tools and extensions to support analysis and review tasks.
  • Execute simple command-line instructions when required to support evaluation workflows.
  • Document findings clearly and communicate insights to stakeholders when needed.


Requirements:

  • Solid comfort using a computer in a professional setting.
  • Experience working with browser extensions and online tools.
  • Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • High attention to detail and ability to justify decisions clearly and objectively.
  • Comfortable working with evaluation frameworks, comparisons, and structured analysis.
  • Good written communication skills in English.


Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work.
  • Familiarity with data quality, content evaluation, or model/output assessments.
  • Background in business analysis, operations, or process improvement.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful research initiatives.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment Required: 30 hours per week minimum.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor/Freelancer (no medical or paid leave).
  • Time Overlap: Some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2–5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles.


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete an analytical challenge.
  • Once the assessment is cleared, you’re ready to start contributing!


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Acquisition Partner em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Talent Acquisition Partner (Active Sourcing)


Location: Fully Remote (Must be based in LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time



About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing consumer products company with more than 5 million customers using our products. Our products are sold not only through DTC and Amazon, but also through major retailers, including Walmart, Target, and Petco, along with more than 10,000 retail doors across the country. Uproot has also been featured across major television and media platforms, including QVC, Good Morning America, and Fox, helping introduce millions of consumers to the brand.

We care deeply about building products that genuinely solve problems for pet owners while operating with high standards across every part of the business. We are building a company focused on long-term excellence, creating significant opportunities for highly capable people who want real and meaningful impact, and the ability to help shape the future of the company.

About the Role

This is a hands-on execution role focused 100% on active sourcing. You will proactively identify and engage high-quality talent across multiple functions and seniority levels using multiple sourcing channels, advanced search techniques, and thoughtful outreach.

Success requires high-output execution, strong judgment, persistence, excellent communication, and the ability to operate with urgency in a fast-moving environment.



Responsibilities


Active Sourcing

  • Proactively source candidates across multiple job boards, platforms, and sourcing channels
  • Use advanced Boolean search techniques to identify strong talent
  • Build pipelines across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Identify strong passive candidates
  • Partner closely with recruiting and hiring managers to align on hiring needs.

Candidate Outreach

  • Write outbound messaging that drives candidate engagement
  • Qualify candidates early in the process
  • Move qualified candidates into the recruiting workflow

Pipeline Management

  • Maintain organized sourcing workflows and candidate tracking
  • Continuously improve sourcing strategies and outreach quality
  • Continuously iterate on sourcing methods, messaging, and targeting

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently builds high-quality candidate pipelines
  • Surfaces strong candidates quickly across multiple functions
  • Generates strong response and assessment completion rates
  • Operates with speed, consistency, and minimal oversight
  • Raises the overall talent bar of the company over time


Requirements

Must Have

  • 1+ year of full-time active sourcing experience - mandatory
  • Experience sourcing across multiple job boards and sourcing platforms
  • Strong outbound recruiting and candidate outreach skills
  • Experience using advanced Boolean search techniques
  • Excellent written English communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple open searches simultaneously

Strong Plus

  • Experience sourcing across multiple functions and seniority levels
  • Experience in high-growth, e-commerce, or performance-driven companies
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter and modern sourcing tools

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup (no digital nomads)

Output: Daily briefs and feedback loops (high consistency required)


Who This Role Is For (& Not For)

This Role Is For You If:

  • You enjoy the challenge of finding exceptional people before anyone else does
  • You are naturally proactive and internally driven
  • You move quickly, stay organized, and maintain high standards
  • You enjoy performance-oriented environments with accountability
  • You think recruiting is a high-leverage business function, not administrative work
  • You enjoy improving systems, processes, and sourcing quality over time

This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You need constant direction or external motivation
  • You struggle with consistency and follow-through
  • You are uncomfortable persuading passive candidates
  • You treat recruiting as scheduling and coordination only


Compensation & Benefits

Uproot Clean is a high ownership, high accountability environment with high standards for communication, speed, execution, and quality. We care far more about ability, judgment, and ownership than credentials or years of experience.

  • Salary : Competitive base salary + performance-based bonus structure
  • Significant autonomy with the ability to directly influence the company’s growth and direction
  • Fully remote : work from anywhere
  • PTO : 2 Weeks
  • Flex Day : An additional quarterly day off dedicated to rest and recovery
  • Thinking Day: one dedicated day each quarter to step away from day-to-day execution and think deeply about your role, systems, ideas, and long-term impact
  • Wellness Reimbursement: $100-$300/month, based on location, to help support your wellness.
  • Pet Reimbursement: $40-100/month, based on location to help support parenting a pet.
  • Coaching credits: $1,000+/year for coaching, education, and professional development


Ready to Apply?

If you are excited by high standards, proactive recruiting, and the challenge of building world-class talent pipelines, we’d love to hear from you.

  • Experiência de trabalho com Metodologias Ágeis e Design Thinking;
  • Experiência em pesquisa de usuários, criação de personas, wireframes e protótipos;

title: Desenvolvedor(a) .NET Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor(a) .NET Sênior em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem somos nós?


Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:


  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?


Como .NET Developer na Builders você irá atuar no desenvolvimento de plataforma, produzindo e otimizando códigos para maior performance, escalabilidade e velocidade. Será responsável pela qualidade e funcionalidade das soluções implementadas.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:


  • Plataforma .NET Core (C#): Sólido conhecimento no desenvolvimento de aplicações utilizando .NET Core.
  • Angular: Experiência prática no desenvolvimento de interfaces com o framework Angular.
  • APIs Web (WebApi): Domínio na criação, consumo e manutenção de APIs RESTful.
  • Bancos de Dados: Conhecimento em bancos relacionais e não relacionais, como SQL Server, MongoDB e Oracle.
  • Testes Automatizados: Experiência na criação de testes de unidade e de integração utilizando ferramentas como xUnit, Moq ou NSubstitute.
  • Controle de Versão: Familiaridade com Git para versionamento de código.
  • Arquitetura de Software e Padrões de Projeto: Conhecimento em DDD (Domain-Driven Design), Design Patterns, arquitetura orientada a eventos (Event-Driven Architecture), microsserviços e práticas de integração e entrega contínua (CI/CD).
  • Boas Práticas de Desenvolvimento: Aplicação de princípios como Clean Code, SOLID, DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself), KISS (Keep It Simple, Stupid) e YAGNI (You Aren’t Gonna Need It).
  • Containers: Conhecimento em Docker para criação e gerenciamento de ambientes isolados.


Será um diferencial se você tiver também:


  • Conhecimento em tecnologias legadas para projetos de migração: Socket, SOAP;
  • Familiaridade com Práticas Ágeis;
  • Mensageria (RabbitMq, Azure Service Bus).


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?


  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.


Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo.

title: Analista de Comunicação e Design
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Comunicação e Design em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.



Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional criativo(a) e apaixonado(a) por comunicação visual para atuar no desenvolvimento de conteúdos gráficos e audiovisuais que apoiem iniciativas de comunicação interna, campanhas corporativas e eventos estratégicos. A posição terá papel fundamental na criação de materiais que fortaleçam o engajamento dos colaboradores, promovam a cultura organizacional e garantam a consistência da identidade visual da empresa.


Principais Responsabilidades


Design de Comunicação e Criação de Conteúdo

• Desenvolver materiais visuais para campanhas internas, eventos corporativos e iniciativas de engajamento.

• Criar apresentações, banners, infográficos, newsletters, layouts para e-mails e demais peças de comunicação digital.


Produção e Edição de Vídeos

• Produzir e editar conteúdos audiovisuais para campanhas de comunicação e iniciativas de engajamento.

• Realizar atividades de pós-produção, incluindo cortes, transições, ajustes de áudio e motion graphics básicos.

• Apoiar a criação de roteiros, storyboards e estratégias de storytelling visual.

• Adaptar vídeos para diferentes canais e plataformas internas.


Suporte a Campanhas e Eventos

• Apoiar o planejamento e a execução de campanhas de comunicação corporativa.

• Desenvolver materiais visuais para eventos presenciais e virtuais, incluindo apresentações, vídeos e identidade visual dos eventos.

• Trabalhar em conjunto com stakeholders para garantir entregas dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.

• Organizar e formatar conteúdos recebidos de diferentes áreas da empresa.


Desenvolvimento de Conteúdo para Comunicação Externa

• Criar materiais gráficos e audiovisuais para apoiar iniciativas da equipe de Comunicação Externa.

• Garantir que os materiais estejam alinhados às diretrizes de marca e comunicação corporativa.

• Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para desenvolver conteúdos de alta qualidade.


Relacionamento com Stakeholders

• Atuar em parceria com as áreas internas para entender necessidades de comunicação e propor soluções criativas.

• Contribuir com ideias inovadoras para aumentar o impacto das comunicações.

• Gerenciar múltiplas demandas simultaneamente, mantendo organização e qualidade nas entregas.


Requisitos

• Formação superior completa em Comunicação, Design, Marketing ou áreas correlatas.

• Experiência prévia com design gráfico, comunicação visual ou produção audiovisual.

• Experiência com edição de vídeo e pós-produção.

• Conhecimento em criação de apresentações corporativas no PowerPoint.

• Vivência com ferramentas de comunicação digital, plataformas de e-mail marketing ou intranet.

• Inglês avançado a fluente para atuação em ambiente global.

• Domínio do Adobe Creative Suite, especialmente:

  • Adobe Premiere Pro
  • Adobe Photoshop
  • Adobe Illustrator
  • Adobe InDesign


Diferenciais

• Conhecimento em Adobe After Effects.

• Experiência com comunicação interna corporativa.

• Conhecimento de branding e estratégias de comunicação.

• Vivência em ambientes multiculturais ou equipes globais.


Atuação no conforto da sua casa sendo 100% remota.

  • Definir, acompanhar e comunicar métricas e indicadores de: Maturidade de governança; Qualidade de dados.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Conhecimento sólido e aplicado em: Catalogação, classificação e gestão de metadados; Qualidade, linhagem e ciclo de vida de dados; Gestão de acessos e proteção de dados sensíveis; LGPD e frameworks de governança e privacidade, como DAMA-DMBOK, ISO 27001 e SOC 2.
  • Experiência atuando em conjunto com: Engenharia de Dados; Analytics; Segurança da Informação; Privacidade.
  • Capacidade de implementar governança de forma prática; automatizada; integrada aos processos.
  • Forte habilidade para: traduzir requisitos regulatórios em controles técnicos aplicáveis; definir métricas e acompanhar evolução de maturidade; navegar com fluidez entre contextos técnicos, jurídicos e de negócio.
  • Excelente comunicação e capacidade de simplificar temas complexos para diferentes públicos (Técnicos; Executivos; Áreas de negócio).
  • Perfil com: Alta autonomia; Visão sistêmica; Capacidade de influência; Forte orientação a impacto e resultados.
  • Capacidade de engajar áreas multifuncionais sem relação hierárquica direta.
  • Perfil colaborativo, pragmático e orientado à construção de soluções escaláveis.

description:

title: Marketing Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Marketing Designer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

AI Marketing Designer


  • Full-time, Remote | US Central Time Business Hours


A letter from our client

Our client wanted us to share this role directly in their own words because they’re looking for someone exceptional to help them continue growing the right way.


Over the past decade, their agency has grown to support 100+ clients across multiple industries, and they are continuing to scale carefully and intentionally. Maintaining a healthy team culture, avoiding burnout, and delivering high-quality work are major priorities for them.

Their clients range from mission-driven organizations changing lives, to restaurant and hospitality brands, to innovative tech companies building exciting products.


In recent years, the agency has become a trusted partner for businesses that previously had poor experiences with marketing agencies and lost confidence in the process. Their mission is not only to deliver great work, but also to help educate businesses on how modern digital marketing should actually be done.


Why this role exists

Currently, the owner personally handles much of the AI-assisted production work within the agency. This includes designing social media content, building websites, generating content with AI tools, and migrating websites onto a modern development stack.


The systems are working extremely well, allowing the agency to move faster than teams much larger in size. However, he has become the bottleneck.


They are now looking for someone who can take ownership of execution so leadership can focus more heavily on strategy, growth, and client relationships.


The role

This position is equal parts:

  • AI fluency
  • Design and web development
  • Both skill sets must be strong.


On the AI side:

Their ideal candidate actively uses tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini as part of a daily workflow. They understand prompting for content, imagery, coding, research, and strategy. They see AI as a multiplier for creativity and execution rather than a replacement for skill.


On the design and development side:

The candidate should be able to design professionally in Canva and Photoshop while maintaining brand consistency across multiple industries and aesthetics. They should also feel comfortable building and migrating websites using tools such as Next.js, Vercel, GitHub, and AI-assisted coding workflows.


The team values people who understand the balance between beautiful design and conversion-focused performance.


Agency experience is strongly preferred, especially for someone familiar with fast turnarounds, proactive communication, and problem-solving before issues escalate.


What the role includes

  • Designing social media content for multiple brands and industries
  • Building and migrating websites onto modern frameworks
  • Using AI tools to accelerate production workflows
  • Assisting with content creation, research, image generation, and code scaffolding
  • Creating designs that are both visually strong and performance-driven
  • Staying current on new AI tools, workflows, and technologies
  • Collaborating with leadership to improve internal systems and efficiency


What our client is looking for

  • Strong AI workflow experience using tools like Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini
  • Experience with AI-assisted coding tools
  • Professional Canva and Photoshop skills
  • Comfort using GitHub, Vercel, and modern web development workflows
  • Basic SEO understanding
  • Strong understanding of social media design across platforms
  • Strong written and spoken English
  • Availability during US Central Time business hours
  • Previous agency experience preferred
  • A highly proactive and self-directed mindset


What they DO NOT want

  • Someone who requires constant follow-up
  • Someone who treats AI as a gimmick or shortcut
  • Someone who forces one design style onto every brand
  • Someone who confuses being busy with being effective
  • Someone unwilling to continuously learn and adapt


Portfolio required

Applicants must submit a live portfolio URL with their application.


Their team would like to see:

  • At least 5 projects
  • A mix of social media and website work
  • At least one live website built end-to-end
  • Optional examples showing how AI supported the workflow


What it’s like working with them

They work hard, move quickly, and genuinely enjoy what they do. Their culture values humility, creativity, initiative, and excellence.


There is strong room for growth within the company. The person who succeeds in this role will likely have opportunities to expand into leadership and strategy over time.


If this role feels like a fit for you, please apply! They are excited to meet the right person! :)

title: AI Technical Lead Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Technical Lead Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

I’m helping FreightPOP find a top candidate to join their team full-time for the role of AI Technical Lead Engineer.


You'll architect and lead AI product development, transforming logistics with intelligent automation.


Compensation:

USD 7k - 16k/month


Location:

Remote (for residents of Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, and the United States)


Mission of FreightPOP:

\"We simplify and streamline the transportation management experience for manufacturers, distributors, retailers, and 3PL’s by reducing friction and connecting systems for a seamless and optimal supply chain.\"


What makes you a strong candidate:

  • You have +8 years experience in Software development.
  • You have +6 years experience in SDLC (Software development life cycle), Agile methodologies.
  • You are proficient in AI agents, AI product development, AWS, machine learning, Microsoft Azure, Python, React.js, software architecture, tech leadership, TypeScript
  • English - Fully fluent.


Responsibilities and more:

Compensation will vary based on Location. Central and South America in the range of $7k to $10k per month. In the US the range will be $12k to $16k per month. Skill and experinece based.

Essential Job Functions/Requirements:


AI Product Development & Technical Leadership:

Lead the technical execution of FreightPOP’s AI product initiatives and roadmap.

Collaborate with Product and Engineering leadership to define and deliver AI-powered capabilities across the platform.

Architect and guide development of AI solutions including copilots, agents, optimization engines, and intelligent automation.

Ensure AI initiatives align with business priorities and deliver measurable value to customers.


Solution Architecture & Platform Integration:

Define technical architecture and development standards for AI-powered capabilities.

Evaluate and select appropriate AI/ML tools, frameworks, vector databases, and supporting infrastructure.

Ensure solutions meet requirements for scalability, reliability, security, and cost efficiency.

Guide integration of AI decisioning with FreightPOP’s core platform systems, including logistics workflows, databases, and operational services.


Hands-on Development & Technical Oversight:

Act as a hands-on contributor while leading technical direction for AI initiatives.

Prototype and validate AI concepts before scaling into production-ready solutions.

Review implementations to ensure alignment with architectural guidance and engineering best practices.

Provide technical mentorship and direction to engineers contributing to AI initiatives.


AI Innovation & Continuous Improvement:

Continuously evaluate emerging AI technologies, tools, and methodologies.

Champion experimentation and innovation within the engineering organization.

Identify opportunities to improve FreightPOP’s platform through AI-driven automation, optimization, and intelligent decision support.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Agile Execution:

Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Infrastructure teams to deliver AI capabilities rapidly and effectively.

Support rapid iteration cycles typical of AI development.

Help guide development practices that balance experimentation speed with production reliability.


Job Qualifications:


Education:

STEM bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.


Experience:

8+ years software development experience with SaaS technology.

6+ years SDLC in an Agile / SCRUM environment.

4+ years in a Senior or Lead engineering role.

Experience building or integrating AI-powered products or platforms.

Experience designing scalable distributed systems.

Logistics or supply chain experience a plus.


Technology Environment:

FreightPOP’s platform is built on a modern SaaS architecture leveraging technologies including:

Backend: C#, .NET APIs and services.

Frontend: React (TypeScript-based UI).

Database: Microsoft SQL Server.

Cloud & Infrastructure: Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS).

The AI Tech Lead will work within this environment while introducing and integrating modern AI technologies such as large language model APIs, AI agents, vector databases, and AI orchestration frameworks as part of FreightPOP’s evolving platform architecture.


Skills & Expertise:

Passion for leveraging AI tools and emerging technologies.

Strong understanding of modern AI ecosystems (LLMs, MCPs, agents, embeddings, vector databases).

Experience building AI-powered software systems or integrating AI capabilities into applications.

Experience designing scalable SaaS architectures and distributed systems.

Ability to rapidly prototype and iterate AI solutions.

Strong problem-solving and technical decision-making skills.

Experience in evaluating and adopting new technologies.

Strong oral and written communication skills.

Ability to collaborate across product, engineering, and leadership teams, including in distributed team environments.


Other Abilities:

Strong curiosity and passion for AI innovation.

Ability to work effectively in fast-paced and evolving technical environments.

Self-driven problem solver capable of working with ambiguity and rapidly evolving requirements.

Commitment to continuous learning and staying current with emerging technologies.


Your potential leaders:

  • Kenin Page
  • Kurt Johnson

title: AI Technical Lead Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Technical Lead Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

I’m helping FreightPOP find a top candidate to join their team full-time for the role of AI Technical Lead Engineer.


You'll architect and lead AI product development, transforming logistics with intelligent automation.


Compensation:

USD 7k - 16k/month


Location:

Remote (for residents of Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, and the United States)


Mission of FreightPOP:

\"We simplify and streamline the transportation management experience for manufacturers, distributors, retailers, and 3PL’s by reducing friction and connecting systems for a seamless and optimal supply chain.\"


What makes you a strong candidate:

  • You have +8 years experience in Software development.
  • You have +6 years experience in SDLC (Software development life cycle), Agile methodologies.
  • You are proficient in AI agents, AI product development, AWS, machine learning, Microsoft Azure, Python, React.js, software architecture, tech leadership, TypeScript
  • English - Fully fluent.


Responsibilities and more:

Compensation will vary based on Location. Central and South America in the range of $7k to $10k per month. In the US the range will be $12k to $16k per month. Skill and experinece based.

Essential Job Functions/Requirements:


AI Product Development & Technical Leadership:

Lead the technical execution of FreightPOP’s AI product initiatives and roadmap.

Collaborate with Product and Engineering leadership to define and deliver AI-powered capabilities across the platform.

Architect and guide development of AI solutions including copilots, agents, optimization engines, and intelligent automation.

Ensure AI initiatives align with business priorities and deliver measurable value to customers.


Solution Architecture & Platform Integration:

Define technical architecture and development standards for AI-powered capabilities.

Evaluate and select appropriate AI/ML tools, frameworks, vector databases, and supporting infrastructure.

Ensure solutions meet requirements for scalability, reliability, security, and cost efficiency.

Guide integration of AI decisioning with FreightPOP’s core platform systems, including logistics workflows, databases, and operational services.


Hands-on Development & Technical Oversight:

Act as a hands-on contributor while leading technical direction for AI initiatives.

Prototype and validate AI concepts before scaling into production-ready solutions.

Review implementations to ensure alignment with architectural guidance and engineering best practices.

Provide technical mentorship and direction to engineers contributing to AI initiatives.


AI Innovation & Continuous Improvement:

Continuously evaluate emerging AI technologies, tools, and methodologies.

Champion experimentation and innovation within the engineering organization.

Identify opportunities to improve FreightPOP’s platform through AI-driven automation, optimization, and intelligent decision support.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Agile Execution:

Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Infrastructure teams to deliver AI capabilities rapidly and effectively.

Support rapid iteration cycles typical of AI development.

Help guide development practices that balance experimentation speed with production reliability.


Job Qualifications:


Education:

STEM bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.


Experience:

8+ years software development experience with SaaS technology.

6+ years SDLC in an Agile / SCRUM environment.

4+ years in a Senior or Lead engineering role.

Experience building or integrating AI-powered products or platforms.

Experience designing scalable distributed systems.

Logistics or supply chain experience a plus.


Technology Environment:

FreightPOP’s platform is built on a modern SaaS architecture leveraging technologies including:

Backend: C#, .NET APIs and services.

Frontend: React (TypeScript-based UI).

Database: Microsoft SQL Server.

Cloud & Infrastructure: Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS).

The AI Tech Lead will work within this environment while introducing and integrating modern AI technologies such as large language model APIs, AI agents, vector databases, and AI orchestration frameworks as part of FreightPOP’s evolving platform architecture.


Skills & Expertise:

Passion for leveraging AI tools and emerging technologies.

Strong understanding of modern AI ecosystems (LLMs, MCPs, agents, embeddings, vector databases).

Experience building AI-powered software systems or integrating AI capabilities into applications.

Experience designing scalable SaaS architectures and distributed systems.

Ability to rapidly prototype and iterate AI solutions.

Strong problem-solving and technical decision-making skills.

Experience in evaluating and adopting new technologies.

Strong oral and written communication skills.

Ability to collaborate across product, engineering, and leadership teams, including in distributed team environments.


Other Abilities:

Strong curiosity and passion for AI innovation.

Ability to work effectively in fast-paced and evolving technical environments.

Self-driven problem solver capable of working with ambiguity and rapidly evolving requirements.

Commitment to continuous learning and staying current with emerging technologies.

  • Kurt Johnson

title: Closer
description:

Descrição da vaga


Como Closer na Nutri de Consultório, você será responsável por conduzir as conversas finais com nutricionistas que já demonstraram interesse na Aceleração Nutri de Consultório (ANC), nosso treinamento principal para nutricionistas que querem estruturar e escalar seus consultórios. Sua missão é entender profundamente a realidade de cada candidata, apresentar a ANC como solução real para as dores dela e conduzir uma venda consultiva. Se você gosta de vender, tem habilidades em vendas de ticket alto e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que está revolucionando a nutrição no Brasil, este é o seu lugar!


Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir reuniões de venda consultiva por vídeo/call com leads qualificados pelo time de SDR
  • Realizar diagnósticos aprofundados das dores, objetivos e contexto de cada candidata antes de apresentar a ANC
  • Apresentar a ANC de forma personalizada, conectando os módulos do treinamento às necessidades reais do lead
  • Identificar, antecipar e quebrar objeções com técnica e empatia (preço, tempo, momento profissional, dúvidas familiares)

  • Negociar condições de pagamento dentro das condições definidas pela empresa
  • Manter o CRM atualizado com status do lead, próximos passos, gravações e insights de cada conversa
  • Bater meta mensal de receita
  • Reportar os feedbacks e objeções recorrentes dos leads para alimentar marketing e produto
  • Acompanhar as suas métricas de desempenho e buscar evolução contínua


Competências

  • Experiência prévia comprovada como Closer ou em vendas consultivas de ticket alto (a partir de R$ 3.000)
  • Domínio de técnicas de fechamento consultivo (SPIN Selling, quebra de objeções, ancoragem de valor, criação de urgência ética)
  • Excelente comunicação verbal (calls) e escrita (follow-ups por WhatsApp e e-mail)
  • Inteligência emocional e resiliência para lidar com objeções e \"nãos\" sem desgaste
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com metas claras e ciclo de venda mais longo
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de CRM e gestão de pipeline
  • Postura consultiva — você ouve antes de falar, entende antes de oferecer
  • Diferencial: conhecimento ou interesse pelo mercado de nutrição ou educação.


Valores da Empresa

Os valores da empresa regem todos os atos de cada pessoa que faz parte da nossa equipe:

- Excelência na entrega

- Aprimoramento constante

- Foco na necessidade dos clientes

- Transparência


Localização: trabalho remoto.


Tipo de contrato: PJ
